title: EVAL-131 exact model configuration identity
description: Every counted held-out observation must quote exactly one object of this shape. EVAL-131 requires at least three distinct exact_model_config_id values across the required coverage; a model NAME is not an identity, because a provider alias can be repointed at new weights without notice.

exact_model_config_id.description: emc_ + the first 32 hex characters of sha256 over the canonical JSON of this object with exact_model_config_id removed. Canonical JSON = json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True).

model_name.description: provider-facing alias, e.g. gemma3:4b. Alias only; never an identity on its own.

model_revision.description: provider-reported revision/tag resolved at call time

weights_digest.description: content digest of the served weights, e.g. the Ollama manifest digest. Use the literal string unresolved when the provider will not disclose it; unresolved forbids qualification for that configuration.

seed.description: integer seed when the provider honours one, otherwise the literal string provider_nondeterministic. A nondeterministic seed is permitted, but it must be declared rather than omitted.

adapter.description: omit entirely when no adapter is applied

host_class.description: coarse hardware class, e.g. workstation_cpu_x86_64 or workstation_cuda. Coarse on purpose: no host secrets or identifiers.

paid.description: true only when the configuration is billed. This freeze is a zero-spend lane and expects false.

cost_usd.description: 0 for zero-spend lanes, a positive number when billed, or the literal string unknown. unknown must never be silently rendered as 0.

per_observation_overhead_fields.note: recorded on the observation, not on the configuration identity

invalidation_rule: if weights_digest, quantization, decoding, runtime.engine_version or any of the frozen *_id fields change, the exact_model_config_id changes and all prior counted observations become a different cell. They must not be pooled.
